channel.title: Notes by Brian Busch
channel.description: Notes on cartography, spatial analysis, and GIS applications by Brian Busch, GISP.

item.title: One place to see the water in the West
item.description: How a job-interview map became the Western Water Dashboard: reservoir storage, snowpack, and drought for eleven western states in one ArcGIS 5.1 application, rebuilt with AI agents under written rules.

item.title: No test goes red on a misleading name
item.description: Most of the Western Water Dashboard was written by AI agents under written rules. The failures that mattered were about meaning, not about code, and the test suite stayed green through all of them.

item.title: One drought dashboard, two WebGL renderers
item.description: A Utah reservoir drought dashboard built on the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JS, then rebuilt in MapLibre GL JS as an open-source parity comparison.

item.title: Turning sidewalk gaps into a connected trail network
item.description: How Millcreek turned a fragmented set of sidewalk and trail studies into one citywide map that a director can act on, with sidewalk data built from aerial imagery.

item.title: Turning a General Plan into a public map
item.description: Millcreek planners lost meeting time flipping through a six-page General Plan appendix. This work turned that appendix into one four foot by six foot wall map of all 13 future land use categories.

item.title: Millcreek Redistricting
item.description: How Millcreek combined ArcGIS Pro analysis and a public StoryMap/Survey123 feedback loop to redraw its City Council districts after the 2020 Census.

item.title: WUI Boundary Mapping
item.description: Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) boundary mapping for Utah local governments, covering HB 48 and HB 41 compliance workflows.

item.title: Alcohol Spacing Regulations
item.description: A map and interactive web app visualizing alcohol-establishment spacing regulations across Millcreek, Utah.

item.title: Keeping neighboring polygons apart
item.description: A Python (ArcPy) script that gives a different color to each adjacent polygon.

item.title: Utah Dark-Sky Points
item.description: Utah's International Dark-Sky Parks mapped as points, for the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge.

item.title: Utah Scenic Byways
item.description: All 27 of Utah's Scenic Byways, 1,893.84 miles of roadway symbolized as line features, for the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge.

item.title: Utah Government Land Ownership
item.description: Government land ownership across Utah, federal agencies and state trust lands, styled in Esri's Firefly look, for the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge.

item.title: Utah Population Hexagons
item.description: Utah Population Density: A Hexagonal Perspective. A 30 Day Map Challenge map that sums Census 2020 population into a 50-square-mile hexagon grid.

item.title: Old Spanish Trail
item.description: The Utah segment of the Old Spanish National Historic Trail, mapped for the A Journey theme of the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge.

item.title: Shading terrain the Imhof way
item.description: An Imhof-inspired hillshade of Utah's terrain, built for the Raster theme of the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge using Esri's Terrain Service.

item.title: Vintage Atlas Style
item.description: Utah's urban areas and rivers in a vintage cartographic style inspired by the 1854 David Rumsey Map Collection, for the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge.

item.title: Utah Localities via HDX
item.description: Utah's populated places mapped from a single humanitarian dataset, for the Humanitarian Data Exchange theme of the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge.

item.title: AI-Generated Fictional Map
item.description: A ChatGPT-generated fictional map of Utah water resources, for the AI theme of the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge. Kept for what it gets wrong.

item.title: Utah Counties, Pen & Paper
item.description: Utah's counties and county seats in a hand-drawn pen-and-paper style, for the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge.

item.title: Avalanche Paths
item.description: A 3D map of avalanche paths in Little Cottonwood Canyon, styled for an Arctic aesthetic, for the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge.

item.title: Utah Time and Space
item.description: Mule deer migration pathways across Utah's Paunsaugunt Plateau, mapped for the Time and Space theme of the 2024 30 Day Map Challenge.
